Fails if chain length or size dominates polarity here."}, {"skill_id": "aromatic_ring_lipophilic_surface", "rules": [{"rule_id": "ring_rich_hydrophobic_surface", "conditions": {"ring_token_bin": "ring_token_high"}, "weight": 0.5, "rationale": "Ring role carried the highest transfer weight (0.758); ring density adds hydrophobic surface and displaces water."}, {"rule_id": "aromatic_ring_coverage", "conditions": {"aromatic_bin": "aromatic_high", "ring_token_bin": "ring_token_high"}, "weight": 0.35, "rationale": "Aromatic ring-rich scaffolds are the concrete carrier of the ring-density effect in this catalog."}, {"rule_id": "hetero_ring_damping", "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_high"}, "weight": -0.35, "rationale": "Heteroatom-rich rings are polar and hydrogen-bonding, damping the hydrophobic ring gain."}, {"rule_id": "low_ring_polar_penalty", "conditions": {"ring_token_bin": "ring_token_low"}, "weight": -0.3, "rationale": "Acyclic or sparse-ring scaffolds expose flexible polar chains to solvent, lowering partition into octanol."}], "ridge": 1.2, "prior_scale": 0.25, "semantic_mass_start": 0.3, "semantic_mass_end": 0.1, "ucb_weight": 0.65, "gp_beta_start": 2.2, "gp_beta_end": 1.0, "gp_xi": 0.01, "confidence": 0.45, "hypothesis": "Transfers the source ring effect directly, treating ring density as the dominant lipophilic surface proxy rather than reversing any source sign; it deliberately avoids the low-confidence length relation. Fails if ring count is confounded with heteroatom content in this pool."}], "selected_skill_id": "hydrophobic_bulk_polarity_balance", "lesson": "Two generations of development seeds agree that the halogen/aromatic surface model with a heteroatom polarity penalty is the reliable signal, while source-derived length transfer stays low-confidence and should be carried only as a structural hedge rather than as a sign-flipped prior.", "revision_summary": "Deployed the domain-mechanistic halogen/aromatic model again, keeping the halogen-aromatic interaction and the heteroatom penalty with a slightly trimmed penalty weight (0.45) and raised confidence (0.72) after it again led the alternative on development seeds (90.05 vs 88.53 AUC). rules.rationale: Halogen substitution adds polarizable hydrophobic volume that favors the octanol phase over water.
Extended aromatic frameworks are poorly hydrated and raise logD independently of chain length.
Halogenated aromatics combine pi-density with lipophilic surface, an additive partition gain.
High heteroatom content means polar and ionizable groups that partition into the aqueous phase.

skills.hypothesis: Lipophilicity in this pool is set by a hydrophobic-surface versus polar-heteroatom balance; halogenation and aromaticity raise the score while heteroatom polarity lowers it. Fails if chain length or size dominates polarity here.

rules.rationale: Ring role carried the highest transfer weight (0.758); ring density adds hydrophobic surface and displaces water.
Aromatic ring-rich scaffolds are the concrete carrier of the ring-density effect in this catalog.
Heteroatom-rich rings are polar and hydrogen-bonding, damping the hydrophobic ring gain.
Acyclic or sparse-ring scaffolds expose flexible polar chains to solvent, lowering partition into octanol.

skills.hypothesis: Transfers the source ring effect directly, treating ring density as the dominant lipophilic surface proxy rather than reversing any source sign; it deliberately avoids the low-confidence length relation. Fails if ring count is confounded with heteroatom content in this pool.

normalized.lesson: Two generations of development seeds agree that the halogen/aromatic surface model with a heteroatom polarity penalty is the reliable signal, while source-derived length transfer stays low-confidence and should be carried only as a structural hedge rather than as a sign-flipped prior.
normalized.revision_summary: Deployed the domain-mechanistic halogen/aromatic model again, keeping the halogen-aromatic interaction and the heteroatom penalty with a slightly trimmed penalty weight (0.45) and raised confidence (0.72) after it again led the alternative on development seeds (90.05 vs 88.53 AUC). Replaced the failed sign-flip skill with a ring-density hedge that uses the highest-transfer-weight ring role without inverting any source effect, and dropped the unverified length rules entirely.
